name: camayoc_dora_open_changes
description: Work in progress (aegis-rb3): changes of one repository opened before the instant and neither merged nor abandoned at it, with their opening time; age is the instant minus opened. From aegis:ChangeEvent. Graphs are bound up front with VALUES (no per-graph string filter): the current and previous monthly window graphs, plus up to 16 exact staged-backfill graphs. An event older than the previous month is not read; its step reads as none/absent. A change opened before the previous month is not seen as open.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> SELECT ?change (MIN(?openedAt) AS ?opened) WHERE { VALUES ?go { <{changeNow}> <{changePrev}> <{staging1}> <{staging2}> <{staging3}> <{staging4}> <{staging5}> <{staging6}> <{staging7}> <{staging8}> <{staging9}> <{staging10}> <{staging11}> <{staging12}> <{staging13}> <{staging14}> <{staging15}> <{staging16}> } GRAPH ?go { ?o a aegis:ChangeEvent ; aegis:changeId ?change ; aegis:changeRepository "{repository}" ; aegis:changeAction "created" ; aegis:occurredAt ?openedAt . } FILTER(STR(?openedAt) < "{end}") FILTER NOT EXISTS { VALUES ?gc { <{changeNow}> <{changePrev}> <{staging1}> <{staging2}> <{staging3}> <{staging4}> <{staging5}> <{staging6}> <{staging7}> <{staging8}> <{staging9}> <{staging10}> <{staging11}> <{staging12}> <{staging13}> <{staging14}> <{staging15}> <{staging16}> } GRAPH ?gc { ?x a aegis:ChangeEvent ; aegis:changeId ?change ; aegis:changeAction ?closing ; aegis:occurredAt ?closedAt . } FILTER(?closing IN ("merged", "abandoned") && STR(?closedAt) < "{end}") } } GROUP BY ?change ORDER BY ?opened

params.name: repository
params.description: change repository as owner/repo

params.name: end
params.description: the instant, RFC 3339 UTC

params.name: changeNow
params.description: change window graph for the window's end month, e.g. https://camayoc.local/window/change/2026-10

params.name: changePrev
params.description: change window graph for the month before changeNow

params.name: staging1
params.description: an exact reviewed staged-backfill graph (aegis-rb3 B2); unused slots carry an IRI with no data, e.g. urn:quipu:import:staging:none
